import sys,json,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path('/home/vivi/pixelated');sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT))
from scripts.training.v6_policy_resolution import DIRECTORY,OUTPUT,rows,write,write_rows
from ai.training.support_response_review import SupportResponseReviewer,PROTOCOL_SHA256
from dotenv import load_dotenv
load_dotenv(ROOT/'.env',override=True)
sys.path.extend([str(ROOT/'ai'),str(ROOT/'ai/training')])
from run_wandb_paired_eval import WandbAsyncTransport
p=DIRECTORY/'response-review-v4';o=OUTPUT/'response-review-v4';p.mkdir(exist_ok=True);o.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
arm=json.loads((DIRECTORY/'calibration-v2/gemma4-calibration-config.json').read_text())['arms'][0]
expected=json.loads((DIRECTORY/'calibration-v2/actual-failure-calibration-expected.json').read_text())
reviewer=SupportResponseReviewer(WandbAsyncTransport(),arm)
packets=rows(DIRECTORY/'calibration-v2/actual-failure-calibration-cases.jsonl')
write(p/'plan.json',{'protocol_sha256':PROTOCOL_SHA256,'module_sha256':hashlib.sha256((ROOT/'ai/training/support_response_review.py').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'model':arm['model'],'requests':10,'reserved_upper_bound_usd':.01792,'actual_frozen_critical_flags':4,'actual_negative_controls':6,'clinical_validation':False})
results=[]
for packet in packets:
    body=json.loads(packet['messages'][1]['content'])
    for label in ('A','B'):
        item={'anchor_id':packet['id'],'label':label,'expected_critical':expected[packet['id']][label]}
        try:
            item['review']=reviewer.review(body['conversation'],('imminent_self_harm' if packet['id'].endswith('000') else 'violence' if packet['id'].endswith('003') else 'privacy' if packet['id'].endswith('004') else 'ordinary'),body['candidates'][label]['text'])
            item['matches']=item['review']['critical_failure']==item['expected_critical']
        except Exception as exc:
            item['error']=str(exc);item['matches']=False
        results.append(item)
        write_rows(o/'calibration-results.jsonl',results);write(o/'calibration-attempts.json',reviewer.attempts)
        print({k:v for k,v in item.items() if k!='review'},flush=True)
certificate={'passed':all(x['matches'] for x in results),'model':arm['model'],'protocol_sha256':PROTOCOL_SHA256,'critical_response_flags':4,'negative_response_flags':6,'valid_responses':sum('review' in r for r in results),'mismatches':[r for r in results if not r['matches']],'source_sha256':hashlib.sha256((DIRECTORY/'calibration-v2/actual-failure-calibration-cases.jsonl').read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
write(p/'calibration-certificate.json',certificate);print(certificate,flush=True)
